description: This file defines a final class `SimpleFileWatcher` that wraps around a `CoalescingFSEventsWatcher` instance to manage starting and stopping file system event watching, encapsulating the watcher’s lifecycle.

classes.name: SimpleFileWatcher
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing file system event watching using `CoalescingFSEventsWatcher`.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stops the watcher upon deinitialization to clean up resources.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the file system event watcher.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the file system event watcher.
